name: Seed v2.0 Tokenizer
pre_tokenizer: Sequence([Split(Qwen2.5/GPT-4-style Isolated regex, behavior=isolated), ByteLevel(add_prefix_space=False, trim_offsets=True, use_regex=False)])
license_policy: Commercial-safe only: Wikipedia, TinyStories, public-domain English (Project Gutenberg / philosophy_pd), and permissive MIT/Apache/BSD/CC-BY/PSF code/math/instruction corpora already used for Seed v4. Drive books and non-permissive sources excluded. Code docs with 'All rights reserved' and no permissive license keyword were skipped.
notes: Best parts of Dionysus 150k (exact 150k ByteLevel BPE, 0 UNK via initial byte alphabet, lossless roundtrip) plus Seed v2.0 upgrades: digit splitting, clean indent runs, chat/tool special tokens, and a balanced English+code+math corpus.
decode_api: tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=False) is required for lossless roundtrip because HuggingFace tokenizers default to skipping special tokens. Chat/control markers are reserved at ids 0-12.
